ticker_news.title: Billionaire David Tepper Is Selling Amazon and Meta Stocks but Betting on Artificial Intelligence (AI) in a Different Way
ticker_news.description: Billionaire David Tepper is reducing his positions in Amazon and Meta, but is investing in Chinese AI stocks like Alibaba and JD.com, as well as utility companies Vistra and NRG Energy, which are benefiting from the growth in data centers supporting AI.
ticker_news.author: The Motley Fool

ticker_news.title: 2 "Magnificent Seven" Stocks Down 19% and 25% You'll Wish You'd Bought on the Dip
ticker_news.description: The recent sell-off in the S&P 500 is giving investors a chance to buy some of America's highest-quality stocks like Microsoft and Amazon at a discount. Both companies are leaders in the growing artificial intelligence (AI) industry, which presents significant financial opportunities.
ticker_news.author: The Motley Fool

ticker_news.title: US Stocks Likely To Open Lower After The Worst Selloff Since 2020: Tariff Announcement Was '100% Smoot Hawley Disguised As Thoughtful Policy,' Says Expert
ticker_news.description: U.S. stock futures declined on Friday after a broad market selloff on Thursday following the introduction of President Trump's tariffs. Experts criticized the tariffs as a 'Smoot Hawley disguised as thoughtful policy', which caused the market to plummet.
ticker_news.author: Rishabh Mishra
